name: vora-js
description: npm workspace for the Vora JavaScript/TypeScript packages

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vorash/sdk && npm run build --workspace @vorash/mcp && npm run build --workspace @vorash/openai-agents && npm run build --workspace @vorash/typesafe-jev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @vorash/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace @vorash/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace @vorash/openai-agents && npm run typecheck --workspace @vorash/typesafe-jev
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @vorash/sdk && npm run test --workspace @vorash/mcp && npm run test --workspace @vorash/openai-agents && npm run test --workspace @vorash/typesafe-jev
